description: This file defines the SugarFieldId class, which extends SugarFieldBase, providing custom sanitization logic for importing data, specifically handling ID fields in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM context.

classes.name: SugarFieldId
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldBase, handling ID field-specific sanitization during data import.

methods.name: importSanitize
